Aasha: Child Development & Early Intervention Centre · Greater Noida

Empowering every child to reach their full potential.

Aasha Child Development & Early Intervention Centre in Gamma 2, Greater Noida provides individualised developmental assessments, speech therapy, occupational therapy, special education, behavioural support and child psychiatric consultation. Care is led by Dr. Anita Sharma and Dr. Sana Firdos. All child-related care on this website comes under Aasha.

Book an AssessmentExplore Our Services

Welcome to Aasha: where hope meets development

Every child holds a unique universe of potential. At Aasha in Greater Noida, we nurture, guide and support children facing developmental, behavioural and learning challenges.

Our multidisciplinary team brings psychiatry, clinical psychology and therapy together to create individualised plans around each child’s neurological, emotional and everyday needs. We combine clinical care with empathy to help children build skills for school, home and community participation.

Guided by expertise, driven by compassion

Dr. Anita Sharma

Consultant Psychiatrist & Clinical Director

Dr. Sharma oversees clinical care and long-term intervention planning, aligning medical, psychological and therapeutic goals. Her approach helps children and parents feel heard and supported from the first consultation.

Meet Dr. Anita Sharma

Dr. Sana Firdos

Clinical Psychologist & Head of Assessments

Dr. Firdos leads cognitive, behavioural and developmental evaluations using standardised psychometric and developmental tools. Findings help families understand their child’s needs and guide an individualised intervention plan.

The Aasha approach

Individualised therapy

Assessment findings and clinical oversight shape a plan for your child’s specific strengths, needs and goals.

Parents as partners

Clear communication and parental coaching help you support your child’s progress beyond the clinic.

Meaningful milestones

We agree practical goals with families and review communication, independence, regulation and participation over time. Progress varies for each child.

A nurturing environment

A warm, sensory-friendly setting helps children feel comfortable, engaged and ready to learn.

Integrated care under one roof

Speech and language therapy

Aasha provides individualised speech and language therapy in Gamma 2, Greater Noida, supporting communication, understanding and expressing language, articulation and social communication.

Occupational therapy

Aasha offers occupational therapy for children in Gamma 2, Greater Noida, focusing on fine motor skills, sensory needs, visual-motor coordination and everyday independence.

Special education and learning support

Aasha provides individualised special education and academic remediation in Greater Noida for children with learning difficulties, including specific learning disabilities.

ABA and behavioural support

Aasha offers individualised ABA and behavioural support in Greater Noida for communication, emotional regulation, positive social participation and everyday life skills.

Child developmental and psychological assessments

Dr. Sana Firdos leads Aasha’s child developmental and psychological assessments in Greater Noida, using cognitive, behavioural and developmental evaluations to guide support.

Child psychiatric consultation

Consult Dr. Anita Sharma at Aasha in Greater Noida for childhood psychiatric and neurodevelopmental concerns, with coordinated psychological assessment and therapy planning.

Conditions and concerns we support

  • Neurodevelopment: autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).
  • Motor and sensory needs: cerebral palsy, sensory processing difficulties, and gross and fine motor delays.
  • Cognition and learning: intellectual disabilities, global developmental delay, dyslexia, dysgraphia and dyscalculia.
  • Communication and behaviour: speech and language delays, aggression, self-injurious behaviour, tantrums and emotional dysregulation.
  • School concerns: academic difficulties, attention and school refusal.

Assessment helps identify which support is appropriate. Explore ADHD and autism assessments, learning assessments and child and student mental health.

Your roadmap to development

  1. Connect and consult

    Begin with Dr. Anita Sharma to discuss your concerns, your child’s development and everyday experiences.

  2. Assess and understand

    Dr. Sana Firdos plans clinical and psychometric assessments around your child’s strengths, challenges and diagnostic needs.

  3. Plan together

    The team develops an individualised roadmap with the appropriate combination of occupational therapy, speech therapy, behavioural support or special education.

  4. Intervene and review

    Therapy begins in a nurturing environment. Progress is reviewed and the plan adjusted as your child’s needs change.

  5. Empower and integrate

    With your involvement and consent, we work with families and schools to help skills carry into home, learning and community life.

A message from our clinical director

“At Aasha, we understand that receiving a developmental diagnosis for your child can feel overwhelming. Our mission is to replace that anxiety with action, clarity, and hope.”

— Dr. Anita Sharma, Consultant Psychiatrist

We are committed to walking alongside families, bringing medical expertise and individualised therapies together so children and parents feel supported.

For medical professionals and referring partners

Aasha welcomes collaboration with paediatricians, neurologists and schools across Greater Noida and the NCR region. Contact our coordination team about referrals, professional progress reports and a clinical detailing session.

Our multidisciplinary approach complements medical management with developmental, behavioural and therapeutic support. Information sharing with referring professionals and schools is coordinated with family consent.

Questions families ask

Where is Aasha Early Intervention Centre?

Aasha is at J-123, J Block, Gamma 2, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310. Call +91 96678 63295 for appointment coordination and directions.

What are Aasha’s clinic hours?

Aasha is open Monday to Saturday from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM and is closed on Sunday. Contact the coordination team to arrange an appointment.

What child development services does Aasha provide?

Aasha provides child psychiatric consultation, clinical psychological and developmental assessments, speech and language therapy, occupational therapy, special education, and ABA and behavioural support. The mix of services is planned for each child.

Who leads care and assessments at Aasha?

Dr. Anita Sharma is Consultant Psychiatrist and Clinical Director. Dr. Sana Firdos is Clinical Psychologist and Head of Assessments.

How do I book a child assessment at Aasha?

Call +91 96678 63295 or use the website’s appointment request form. Share your child’s main concerns and any earlier reports so the coordination team can help arrange the appropriate first step.

How is Aasha related to the services on the Mind Grace website?

All child-related care on this website comes under Aasha Child Development & Early Intervention Centre. Adult care and academic training continue under Mind Grace.

Our single-child check-in helps you organise everyday observations for a conversation with a professional. It is a discussion aid, not a diagnostic test.
